title: SHL Resourcepack
description: SHL Resourcepack for use on Santoria, in Santoria Hockey League matches.
body:
# Introduction

This is the official SHL (Santoria Hockey League) resourcepack for use on Santoria. It retextures the hockey sticks to be actual hockey sticks. This is in no way allifiated with the official Santoria resourcepack, all bugs and issues should go to Ethan. 

## Instructions for installation:

- Download the pack
- Ensure your minecraft version is 1.21.5+
- Install a serverpack unlocker mod (Recommended is Server Pack Unlocker)
- Install ETF and EMF (Option but necessary for hockey pucks)
- Go to the title screen > Options > Resource Packs > Open Pack Folder
- Put the .zip file in that folder
- Hop onto the server and enjoy!
  
## Features:

### Hockey sticks:

Wooden daggers with knockback 1 and 2 (only) will now be retextured to look like hockey sticks. This is a **1.21.5+** feature, if you use this on 1.21.4 it will not work. 

### Pucks 

All wooden boats are now changed in model but not in item to be hitbox-specific hockey pucks. This is a CEM feature, it requires the mods EMF and ETF to work. 


### Future features:

 - Customised hockey sticks - contact Ethan for more info in DMs or in the hockey guild.
